name: Activehotel Bergkönig
beschreibung: Activehotel Bergkönig is located in Neustift im Stubaital, near the valley station of the Stubai Glacier cable car. The property is run as an active hotel, giving guests direct access to the valley's hiking, cycling, and skiing areas. Amenities include a wellness area with a sauna and swimming pool. Dining is available at the on-site restaurant serving regional cuisine. Guest rooms are individually appointed, some featuring a private balcony. Rental equipment for winter and alpine sports is conveniently available in-house. The hotel caters especially to active and sports-minded travelers.
